notes: Fresh calibration-efficiency frontier. A separate mature training cohort contributes full 4.75 s summary estimates; learned groups and control-aware rank-1/rank-2 backbones are frozen before unseen test clients. Test methods receive identical cumulative prefixes: three 0.25 s records followed by up to two 2 s complementary-speed records, with the final record truncated to the stated budget. Learned clients fit each candidate head on the available prefix and select the lowest normalized output-error candidate. OracleGroupRank2 uses the true test family only as attribution. Primary gate: LearnedRank2 at 1.25 s must be within 2% of Local at 1.75 s.
